steps.instruction: In a bowl, combine 1 cup of baking mix, 1 egg and 1/4 cup of brown sugar.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, 1/4 teaspoon of ginger and 1/4 teaspoon of nutmeg.
Rub 1 ounce of butter into the mixture with your fingers.
steps.spoken: Rub 1 ounce of butter into the mixture with your fingers. The mixture should not be sticky.

steps.instruction: Line an 8 by 8-inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Press the mixture into the bottom of the baking pan.
steps.spoken: Press the mixture into the bottom of the baking pan. You might want to press it up the sides a little.

steps.instruction: Toss 2 sliced apples in 1 dash of grapefruit or lemon juice.
steps.spoken: Toss 2 sliced soft-textured apples in 1 dash of grapefruit or lemon juice, spreading the juice evenly.

steps.instruction: Combine 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, 1/4 teaspoon of ginger and 1/4 teaspoon of nutmeg.
Add 3 tablespoons of baking mix and 3 tablespoons of brown sugar and combine.
Toss most of the spice mixture with the apples.
steps.spoken: Toss most of the spice mixture with the apples. Keep the rest to the side.

steps.instruction: Tip the apples onto the base in the pan.
steps.spoken: Tip the lightly coated apples on top of the base in the pan. Try to arrange the slices in an even layer.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle the remaining spice mixture over the apples.
Let it cool, then lift it out by the corners of the paper.
steps.spoken: Let it cool. Then lift it out of the pan by the corners of the parchment paper and put it on a plate for easy slicing.
